Algorithm: speed factor = n above 3000 to 1.5, above 1500 to 1.2, above 500 to 1.0, otherwise 0.9; corrected power = power times speed factor; among the chain table 06B (9.525 mm / 3 kW / 9000 rpm), 08A (12.7 / 10 / 7000), 10A (15.875 / 20 / 5000), 12A (19.05 / 40 / 3500), 16A (25.4 / 80 / 2500), 20A (31.75 / 150 / 1800), 24A (38.1 / 250 / 1300) take the first chain number satisfying both maxKw at least corrected power and maxRpm at least n; small-sprocket teeth z1 by n: above 2000 to 25, above 1000 to 21, otherwise 17, forced odd; z2 = round(z1 times i), if even then plus 1; chain speed v = z1 times pitch times n / (60 times 1000) (m/s); recommended center distance = 40 times pitch; pitch count = round(2a/p + (z1+z2)/2 + ((z2-z1)/(2pi))^2 times p/a), if odd then plus 1. Lubrication: v below 0.6 grease, below 8 oil-bath, otherwise oil-spray.
map.例：5.5kW、960rpm、i=3 → 速度系数 1.0、修正功率 5.5kW: Example: 5.5 kW, 960 rpm, i = 3 gives speed factor 1.0, corrected power 5.5 kW, select 08A (pitch 12.7 mm), z1 = 17, z2 = 51, chain speed 3.45 m/s, large-sprocket speed 320 rpm, center distance 508 mm, chain 116 pitches, judged as medium-speed drive, oil-bath lubrication. If power raised to 30 kW, n = 1450 gives speed factor 1.0 (1450 not above 1500), select 12A (19.05 mm), z1 = 21, z2 = 63 (i = 3), chain speed 9.62 m/s, judged as high-speed drive, oil-spray lubrication. If n = 400 rpm, 2.2 kW gives speed factor 0.9, corrected power 1.98 kW, still select 06B (9.525 mm), z1 = 17.
